footnote_text: Represents awards of restricted stock units ("RSUs") of the Issuer granted to Mr. Masson under the Issuer's 2025 Long-Term Incentive Plan, consisting of (i) 975,000 RSUs granted as a one-time sign-on award that will vest on the first anniversary of the date of grant and (ii) 66,479 RSUs that will generally vest in one-third installments on the first, second, and third anniversaries of the date of grant, in each case subject to Mr. Masson's continued service relationship with the Issuer through such date.
